title: Deploy the cli-login broker for prospectus.anth.us
description:
Deploy cli-login's broker (`infra/broker.yaml`, at the same cli-login version the pages use) for prospectus.anth.us.

Parameters:
- Targets: `["https://prospectus.anth.us"]`.
- ApprovalUrl: `https://prospectus.anth.us/cli/approve`.
- CallbackUri: `https://prospectus.anth.us/cli/callback`.
- ClientId: the CRM browser client.
- InvokerRoleArn: the role that serves the pages.

Build the code with cli-login's `scripts/build_broker.py`, which is deterministic and prints the S3 key.

This stack adds IAM resources and a public function URL. Show Ryan the change set and get his concrete approval before executing it (AGENTS.md).

Add the CRM client callback `https://prospectus.anth.us/cli/callback` in `infra/lib/prospectus-backend.ts` with a spec, the way #91 added the Cyclotron lab's.

Done when: the stack is deployed, `POST /start` on the function URL answers a transaction, and the private operations refuse a public caller.
